name: frie
description: Brandon Frie's agent skills and hooks, as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: frie-core
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's language-neutral engineering patterns and prose style, a hook that denies a code edit until engineering-patterns is loaded, and a hook that flags British spellings.

plugins.name: frie-enterprise
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's practices for services and business applications: layering, data access, performance, observability, and integration testing, layered on his engineering patterns.

plugins.name: frie-dotnet
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's C# and .NET language standards, and a hook that denies a C# or Razor edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-aspnet
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's standards for .NET services and Blazor apps: hosting, layering, data access, and Blazor, layered on his C# and enterprise standards, and a hook that denies a C# or Razor edit outside a game project until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-python
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's Python standards, and a hook that denies a Python edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-java
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's Java standards, and a hook that denies a Java or Gradle edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: frie-neoforge
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's NeoForge Minecraft mod conventions, layered on his Java standards, and a hook that denies a mod edit until the references for its NeoForge version are read.

plugins.name: frie-typescript
plugins.description: Brandon Frie's TypeScript and React standards, and a hook that denies a TypeScript edit until its references are read.

plugins.name: secret-files-guard
plugins.description: Denies tool calls that reach a secrets file (.env, *.local.json, credential stores, private keys) through a path or a glob.
